kind: Explicit host registration loader and scoped reader ownership

coverage: Unregistered path rejected before reading or opening Git
Changed configuration rejected before Git open
Mutable input mappings copied; duplicate registrations reject
Partial repository open failure closes already-open reader
Verifier construction failure closes all readers

limitations: Registration is explicit trusted application input, not an approval grant
Default standalone registration channel still requires an explicit contract
No TOML extension, environment-variable protocol or content-selected Python plugin introduced
Working-tree mode and runtime acceptance remain open
publication: Local tooling commit only; no remote push or release tag
